reading.title: The Pet Shop: Simple Message
reading.text: Maya takes a shopping basket and checks a price tag on the shelf. A poster explains the shop’s services. A fish swims in the tank, and a bowl is on another shelf. She chooses a toy from the toy rack. Before leaving, she asks how to feed, walk, groom, bathe and train her dog. She also asks which games they can play together.
reading.imageBrief: Pet shop with shopping basket, toy rack, plain shelf and maintained aquarium. Blank service poster, no readable prices or animal-care procedure.

reading.title: The Pet Shop: Notice-Style Text
reading.text: Omar wants to adopt a pet from a rescue centre. He asks about the animal’s needs before making a decision. The staff explain its daily care and arrange another visit. Omar wants to be sure that his home and routine are suitable. He does not choose a pet only because of a photograph.
reading.imageBrief: Adult speaking with rescue staff at a desk beside an unlettered animal-profile folder. No implication that a purchase alone establishes responsible adoption.
